description_en: Queries the list of published Data Service APIs
description_zh: 调用ListDataServicePublishedApis获取数据服务API的发布态信息列表
name: ListDataServicePublishedApis

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大50条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh:
工作空间的ID。

示例值仅用于展示格式；有效值可通过 ListProjects 响应中的 PageResult.ProjectList[].ProjectId 获取。调用前需开通 DataWorks 企业版或旗舰版，未开通时会返回 403 Forbidden.Access
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the DataStudio page, click your username in the upper-right corner, and select Menu > User Info
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to filter APIs by name. APIs whose names contain this keyword are returned
parameters.help_zh: API名称的关键词，过滤得到API名称包含该关键词的API
parameters.name: api_name_keyword

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to filter APIs by path. APIs whose paths contain this keyword are returned
parameters.help_zh: API路径的关键词，过滤得到API路径包含该关键词的API
parameters.name: api_path_keyword

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud ID of the API creator. Only APIs created by this user are returned
parameters.help_zh: API创建者的阿里云ID，过滤得到该用户创建的API
parameters.name: creator_id
